import json
import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from solution import freeze_report, thaw_report


class ReportSerializationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_deterministic_freeze_and_tuple_restoration(self):
        report = {
            "title": "Chart",
            "points": [(1, 2.5), (-3, 0)],
            "meta": {"z": [True, None], "a": {"count": 2}},
        }
        expected = b'{"meta":{"a":{"count":2},"z":[true,null]},"points":[[1,2.5],[-3,0]],"title":"Chart"}'
        self.assertEqual(freeze_report(report), expected)
        thawed = thaw_report(expected)
        self.assertEqual(thawed, report)
        self.assertIsInstance(thawed["points"][0], tuple)
        self.assertIsInstance(thawed["points"][1], tuple)

    def test_empty_values_and_independent_objects(self):
        report = {"title": "", "points": [], "meta": {"nested": [1]}}
        snapshot = deepcopy(report)
        blob = freeze_report(report)
        self.assertEqual(report, snapshot)
        report["meta"]["nested"].append(2)
        thawed = thaw_report(blob)
        self.assertEqual(thawed, snapshot)
        thawed["meta"]["nested"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(report["meta"]["nested"], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(thaw_report(freeze_report({"title": "x", "points": [], "meta": {}})),
                         {"title": "x", "points": [], "meta": {}})

    def test_freeze_schema_and_coordinate_validation(self):
        invalid_type_reports = [
            [],
            {"title": "x", "points": []},
            {"title": "x", "points": [], "meta": {}, "extra": 1},
            {"title": 1, "points": [], "meta": {}},
            {"title": "x", "points": (), "meta": {}},
            {"title": "x", "points": [], "meta": []},
            {"title": "x", "points": [[1, 2]], "meta": {}},
            {"title": "x", "points": [(1,)], "meta": {}},
            {"title": "x", "points": [(True, 2)], "meta": {}},
            {"title": "x", "points": [("1", 2)], "meta": {}},
        ]
        for report in invalid_type_reports:
            with self.subTest(report=report):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    freeze_report(report)
        for coordinate in (float("inf"), float("-inf"), float("nan")):
            with self.subTest(coordinate=coordinate):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    freeze_report({"title": "x", "points": [(coordinate, 0)], "meta": {}})

    def test_invalid_metadata_is_rejected(self):
        reports = [
            {"title": "x", "points": [], "meta": {"bad": object()}},
            {"title": "x", "points": [], "meta": {"bad": float("nan")}},
        ]
        for report in reports:
            with self.subTest(report=report):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    freeze_report(report)

    def test_thaw_requires_bytes_and_converts_all_failures_to_value_error(self):
        for blob in ("{}", bytearray(b"{}"), memoryview(b"{}")):
            with self.subTest(blob=blob):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    thaw_report(blob)
        invalid_blobs = [
            b"\xff",
            b"not json",
            b"[]",
            b'{"title":"x","points":[],"meta":{},"extra":1}',
            b'{"title":"x","points":[[1]],"meta":{}}',
            b'{"title":"x","points":[[true,2]],"meta":{}}',
            b'{"title":"x","points":[[1e999,2]],"meta":{}}',
            b'{"title":"x","points":[],"meta":{"bad":NaN}}',
        ]
        for blob in invalid_blobs:
            with self.subTest(blob=blob):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    thaw_report(blob)

    def test_round_trip_unicode(self):
        report = {"title": "Δ report", "points": [(1.25, -2)], "meta": {"note": "雪"}}
        blob = freeze_report(report)
        self.assertIsInstance(blob, bytes)
        self.assertEqual(thaw_report(blob), report)
        json.loads(blob.decode("utf-8"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
